# Differential Expression Analysis
## Volcano for DE_ASPC
```{r Volcano_DE_ASPC}
getwd()
DE_ASPC<- read.csv("./DE_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/ASPC-HFSC_vs_ASPC-Chow/DE_results_ASPC-HFSC_vs_ASPC-Chow.csv")
head(DE_ASPC) #gene p_val avg_log2FC pct.1 pct.2 p_val_adj
colnames(DE_ASPC)[1:3] <- c("Gene","P.Value","logFC","pct.1","pct.2","adjP.Value")
rownames(DE_ASPC) <- DE_ASPC$Gene
head(DE_ASPC)
x <- DE_ASPC

logFCcut <- 1 #log2-foldchange
pvalCut <- 1e-2 #P.value
adjPcut <- 0.1 #adj.P.value

#for advanced mode
logFCcut2 <- 2 
logFCcut3 <- 5
pvalCut2 <- 1e-10
pvalCut3 <- 1e-20

#置x，y軸的最大最小位置
xmin <- (range(x$logFC)[1]- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ 10))
xmax <- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ (10-range(x$logFC)[1]))
ymin <- 0
ymax <- -log10(x$P.Value)[3] * 1.1

# 基因名的颜色，需大于等于pathway的数量，这里自定义了足够多的颜色
mycol <- c("darkgreen","chocolate4","blueviolet","#223D6C","#D20A13","#088247","#58CDD9","#7A142C","#5D90BA","#431A3D","#91612D","#6E568C","#E0367A","#D8D155","#64495D","#7CC767")

# 複雜的的setting for color
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
cols <- rep("grey", n1)
names(cols)<- rownames(x)

#不同阈值的点的颜色
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#FB9A99"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- "#ED4F4F"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#B2DF8A"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#329E3F"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#f77e7e"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2]<- "#c21b2b"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#73b6f5"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#136cbf"
color_transparent <- adjustcolor(cols, alpha.f = 0.5)
x$color_transparent <- color_transparent

# 複雜的的setting for size
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
size <- rep(1, n1)

#不同阈值的点的大小
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC > logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC > logFCcut3]<- 6
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC < -logFCcut3]<- 6

# Construct the plot objASPCt
#BiocManager::install('ggthemes')
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)
library(gridExtra)
p1 <- ggplot(data=x, aes(logFC, -log10(P.Value), label = Gene, color = pathway)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = size, colour = x$color_transparent) +

  labs(x=bquote(~Log[2]~"(fold change)"), y=bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")), title="") + 
  ylim(c(ymin,ymax)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-5, -2,-logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2, 5), #刻度线的位置
    labels = c(-5, -2, -logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2 , 5),
    limits = c(-10, 10) #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看
  ) +
  #或用下面这行：
  #xlim(c(xmin, xmax)) + 

#画阈值分界线
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut, logFCcut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) + #虚线的形状和粗细
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
  
theme_bw(base_size = 10#, base_family = "Times" #修改字体
         ) +
theme(panel.grid=element_blank())

p1 <- p1 + 
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut2, logFCcut2), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut2), color="grey40", 
             linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1)

# 显示 logFC > n 的基因的基因名
n = 2
p1 + geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC,
                         y = -log10(P.Value),
                         label = ifelse(logFC > n & -log10(P.Value) > 5, rownames(x),"")),
                     colour="#9c0917", size = 3, box.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
                     point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC, 
                      y = -log10(P.Value), 
                      label = ifelse(logFC < -n & -log10(P.Value) > 5, rownames(x),"")),
                  colour="#0054a3", size = 3, box.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"), 
                  point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines"))
ggsave("./DE_ASPC/DE_ASPC_volcano.pdf", width=6,height=6)
ggsave("./DE_ASPC/DE_ASPC_volcano.png", width=6,height=6)
```

## Bubble for DE_ASPC_top
```{r Bubble_ASPC_top}
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
data <- DE_ASPC
data_up <- subset(data,logFC>0)[1:20,1:6]
data_down <- subset(data,logFC<0)[1:20,1:6]
data_top20 <- rbind(data_up,data_down)
data_top20 <- dplyr::arrange(data_top20,logFC)
data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value == 0] <- min(data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value > 0])/100
# data_top20 <- data_top20[order(data_top20$logFC, decreasing = F),]
# min_nonzero_value <- min(data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value != 0])
# data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value == 0] <- min_nonzero_value * 1e-2

# Convert Symbol to a factor to control the order of plotting 
data_top20$Gene <- factor(data_top20$Gene, levels = unique(data_top20$Gene))

# Map shapes and colors based on LogFC
data_top20$Shape <- ifelse(data_top20$logFC > 0, 24, 25) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data_top20$Color <- ifelse(data_top20$logFC > 0, "#DA7680", "#72A7D9")
data_top20$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data_top20$logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
                          levels = c("Up", "Down"))
# Plot
ggplot(data_top20, aes(x=logFC, y=Gene, size=-log10(P.Value), shape=Regulation, color=Regulation)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#DA7680", "Down" = "#72A7D9")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color="black",face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top20 Up- & Down-regulated Genes in ASPCs",
       size = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P.Value")),
       x="LogFC", 
       y="Gene Symbol",
       color = "Gene Regulation",
       shape = "Gene Regulation")+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-5, 0, 5), #刻度线的位置
    labels = c(-5, 0, 5),
    limits = c(-6, 6.1)  #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看 
  ) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17))) 

# Save the plot
ggsave("./DE_ASPC/DE_ASPC_top20_logFC.pdf", width=5, height=8)
ggsave("./DE_ASPC/DE_ASPC_top20_logFC.png", width=5, height=8,dpi = 600)
```

# ASPC Functional Analysis
```{r label_wrap}
# 构建一个防通路名太长的函数
label_wrap <- function(label, width) {
  sapply(label, function(x) {
    words <- strsplit(x, " ")[[1]]
    lines <- ""
    current_line <- ""
    for (word in words) {
      if (nchar(current_line) + nchar(word) + 1 > width) {
        lines <- paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
        current_line <- word
      } else {
        if (current_line == "") {
          current_line <- word
        } else {
          current_line <- paste(current_line, word)
        }
      }
    }
    paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
  })
}
```
## Canonical Pathways
```{r IPA_cano}
data <- read_excel("./DE_ASPC/IPA_canonical.xlsx")
data <- data[order(data$`zScore`, decreasing = TRUE),]
data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways` <- factor(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                                              levels = rev(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`))

data$Shape <- ifelse(data$zScore > 0, 24, ifelse(data$zScore < 0, 25, 21)) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$zScore > 0, "Up", ifelse(data$zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")), levels = c("Up", "Down","NA"))

# Plot
ggplot(data, aes(x=zScore, 
                 y=`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                 size=Ratio*100, 
                 shape=Regulation, 
                 color=`-log(p-value)`)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top 10 Up- & Down-regulated Canonical Pathways in ASPCs",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 47))+
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))
ggsave("./DE_ASPC/Cano_top20.pdf", width=7, height=6)
```

## Cano_ChordPlot
```{r cano_chord}
data <- read_excel("./DE_ASPC/IPA_canonical_chord2.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- DE_ASPC
#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data[1:6,],!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)

# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)

ind <- gsub("Clec4c", "Clec4b1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr1a", "Fcgr1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr2a", "Fcgr3", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr3a/Fcgr3b", "Fcgr4", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lilrb3", "Pirb", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lyz", "Lyz1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Tpsab1/Tpsb2", "Tpsb2", ind)
ind <- gsub("C4a/C4b", "C4b", ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-A", "H2-Q10", ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqa1", "H2-Aa", ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqb1", "H2-Ab1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Drb5", "H2-Eb1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Dmb", "H2-DMb1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Serpina3", "Serpina3n", ind)

logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,logFC)


#自定义颜色；
# mycol <- c("#9dacb3","#896f96","#003a6c","#db6000","#f2c76d","#0077c1","#d982ba","#5ea6a3")
# mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#ffd580","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478","#0078ab")
mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478")
#mycol <- c("#ffadad","#ffd6a5","#fdffb6","#caffbf","#9bf6ff","#a0c4ff","#bdb2ff","#ffc6ff")
# mycol <- c("#7C4697","#5D90BA","#5ea6a3","#D8D155","#cf7685")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'),
        limit = c(1,0),
        title = "Genes Significantly Impacting Pathways \nin ASPCs after 24-week HFSC Diet") 
ggsave("./DE_ASPC/IPA_canonical_chord2.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.45)
```

## Clustered DotPlot for Cell types

```{r Clustered_DotPlot}
seen_genes <- c()
filtered_pathway_lists <- lapply(pathway_genes_named_filtered, function(genes) { # 遍历每个 pathway list，并根据优先级去重
  unique_genes <- genes[!genes %in% seen_genes] # 筛选未见过的基因
  seen_genes <<- c(seen_genes, unique_genes) # 更新已见基因集合
  return(unique_genes)
})
```

```{r Volcano_DE_MEC}
# 複雜的的setting for color
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
cols <- rep("grey", n1)
names(cols)<- rownames(x)

#不同阈值的点的颜色

#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- "#ED4F4F"

cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#f77e7e"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2]<- "#c21b2b"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#73b6f5"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#136cbf"

# 複雜的的setting for size
```

## Canonical Pathways
```{r IPA_Areg_cano}
data <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/Areg_pw_selected.xlsx")
data <- data[order(data$`zScore`, decreasing = TRUE),]
data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways` <- factor(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                                              levels = rev(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`))

data$Shape <- ifelse(data$zScore > 0, 24, ifelse(data$zScore < 0, 25, 21)) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$zScore > 0, "Up", ifelse(data$zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")), levels = c("Up", "Down","NA"))

# Plot
ggplot(data, aes(x=zScore, 
                 y=`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                 size=Ratio*100, 
                 shape=Regulation, 
                 color=`-log(p-value)`)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top Canonical Pathways in Aregs \n24-week HFSC Diet",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 47))+
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/Cano_Areg.pdf", width=7, height=6)
```

## Cano_ChordPlot
```{r cano_chord}
data <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/Areg_Chord_input.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/Areg_DEGs.xlsx")
colnames(expr)[4] <- "logFC"
expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
row.names(expr) <- expr$ID

#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data,!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)

# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)
logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
ID <- expr[ind,]$ID
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,ID,logFC)
rownames(mat2) <- mat2$ID
mat2 <- mat2 %>% dplyr::select(-ID)

#自定义颜色；
# mycol <- c("#9dacb3","#896f96","#003a6c","#db6000","#f2c76d","#0077c1","#d982ba","#5ea6a3")
# mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffd580","#ffeabf","#bfecff","#80d9ff","#005478","#0078ab")
# mycol <- c("#FFC0C6","#FF5630","#FA6A10","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#1C98B9","#B6AAE3")
mycol <- c("#FFC0C6","#FF5630","#F2A816","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#B6AAE3")
# mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478")
#mycol <- c("#ffadad","#ffd6a5","#fdffb6","#caffbf","#9bf6ff","#a0c4ff","#bdb2ff","#ffc6ff")
# mycol <- c("#7C4697","#5D90BA","#5ea6a3","#D8D155","#cf7685")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'),
        limit = c(1,0),
        title = "Genes Significantly Impacting Pathways \nin Aregs after 24-week HFSC Diet") 
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/Chord_Areg.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.8)
```

### Clustered DotPlot for subtypes
```{r Clustered_DotPlot}
genelist <- subset(mat2, select = -logFC)
pathway_genes_named <- lapply(names(genelist), function(pathway) {
  rownames(genelist)[genelist[[pathway]] == 1]
})
names(pathway_genes_named) <- names(genelist)
# 查看结果
print(pathway_genes_named)

expr <- DE_Areg
expr_filter <- expr[abs(expr$logFC) >= 2 & expr$P.Value < 0.01, ]
pathway_genes_named_filtered <- lapply(pathway_genes_named, function(genes) {
  intersect(genes, expr_filter$Gene)
})
all_genes <- unlist(pathway_genes_named_filtered)
# 查看基因出现次数
gene_counts <- table(all_genes)
# 筛选出重复基因
duplicated_genes <- names(gene_counts[gene_counts > 1])
# 打印重复基因及其出现次数
print(gene_counts[gene_counts > 1])

seen_genes <- c()
filtered_pathway_lists <- lapply(pathway_genes_named_filtered, function(genes) { # 遍历每个 pathway list，并根据优先级去重
  unique_genes <- genes[!genes %in% seen_genes] # 筛选未见过的基因
  seen_genes <<- c(seen_genes, unique_genes) # 更新已见基因集合
  return(unique_genes)
})
levels(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new) <- c("RMP-HFSC","RMP-Chow","FAP-HFSC","FAP-Chow","PreA-HFSC","PreA-Chow","Areg-HFSC","Areg-Chow","ASC-HFSC","ASC-Chow")
pdf(file=sprintf('./pathway_gene/ASPC/Top_drivers_Dotplot_Areg1.pdf'),width=10,height=5)
p <- DotPlot(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new, 
              features = filtered_pathway_lists, 
              dot.scale = 8,
              cols = "RdBu") +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color="black"), #面板边框
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
    #strip.background = element_rect(color="red"),
    strip.text = element_text(margin=margin(b=3, unit="mm")),
    strip.placement = 'outlet', 
    axis.line = element_blank(),
  ) +
  labs(x="", y="",title = "Top Driver Expression of the Areg Significant Pathway")
print(p)
cat("\n")
dev.off()
```

## Canonical Pathways
```{r IPA_FAP_cano}
data <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/FAP_pw_selected.xlsx")
data <- data[order(data$`zScore`, decreasing = TRUE),]
data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways` <- factor(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                                              levels = rev(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`))

data$Shape <- ifelse(data$zScore > 0, 24, ifelse(data$zScore < 0, 25, 21)) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$zScore > 0, "Up", ifelse(data$zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")), levels = c("Up", "Down","NA"))

# Plot
ggplot(data, aes(x=zScore, 
                 y=`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                 size=Ratio*100, 
                 shape=Regulation, 
                 color=`-log(p-value)`)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top Canonical Pathways in FAPs \n24-week HFSC Diet",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 47))+
```

## Cano_ChordPlot
```{r cano_chord}
data <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/FAP_Chord_input.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/FAP_DEGs.xlsx")
colnames(expr)[4] <- "logFC"
expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
row.names(expr) <- expr$ID

#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data,!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)

# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)
logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
ID <- expr[ind,]$ID
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,ID,logFC)
rownames(mat2) <- mat2$ID
mat2 <- mat2 %>% dplyr::select(-ID)

#自定义颜色；
# mycol <- c("#9dacb3","#896f96","#003a6c","#db6000","#f2c76d","#0077c1","#d982ba","#5ea6a3")
# mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffd580","#ffeabf","#bfecff","#80d9ff","#005478","#0078ab")
# mycol <- c("#FFC0C6","#FF5630","#FA6A10","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#1C98B9","#B6AAE3")
mycol <- c("#FFC0C6","#FF5630","#F2A816","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#B6AAE3")
# mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478")
#mycol <- c("#ffadad","#ffd6a5","#fdffb6","#caffbf","#9bf6ff","#a0c4ff","#bdb2ff","#ffc6ff")
# mycol <- c("#7C4697","#5D90BA","#5ea6a3","#D8D155","#cf7685")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'),
        limit = c(1,0),
        title = "Genes Significantly Impacting Pathways \nin FAPs after 24-week HFSC Diet") 
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/Chord_FAP.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.8)
``` 
### Clustered DotPlot for subtypes
```{r Clustered_DotPlot}
genelist <- subset(mat2, select = -logFC)
pathway_genes_named <- lapply(names(genelist), function(pathway) {
  rownames(genelist)[genelist[[pathway]] == 1]
})
names(pathway_genes_named) <- names(genelist)
# 查看结果
print(pathway_genes_named)

expr <- DE_FAP
expr_filter <- expr[abs(expr$logFC) >= 2 & expr$P.Value < 0.01, ]
pathway_genes_named_filtered <- lapply(pathway_genes_named, function(genes) {
  intersect(genes, expr_filter$Gene)
})
all_genes <- unlist(pathway_genes_named_filtered)
# 查看基因出现次数
gene_counts <- table(all_genes)
# 筛选出重复基因
duplicated_genes <- names(gene_counts[gene_counts > 1])
# 打印重复基因及其出现次数
print(gene_counts[gene_counts > 1])


seen_genes <- c()
filtered_pathway_lists <- lapply(pathway_genes_named_filtered, function(genes) { # 遍历每个 pathway list，并根据优先级去重
  unique_genes <- genes[!genes %in% seen_genes] # 筛选未见过的基因
  seen_genes <<- c(seen_genes, unique_genes) # 更新已见基因集合
  return(unique_genes)
})

#filtered_pathway_lists_cd74 <- append(filtered_pathway_lists, list("Antigen Presentation Pathway"="Cd74"))

levels(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new) <- c("RMP-HFSC","RMP-Chow","FAP-HFSC","FAP-Chow","PreA-HFSC","PreA-Chow","Areg-HFSC","Areg-Chow","FAP-HFSC","FAP-Chow")
pdf(file=sprintf('./pathway_gene/ASPC/Top_drivers_Dotplot_FAP1.pdf'),width=10,height=5)
p <- DotPlot(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new, 
              features = filtered_pathway_lists, 
              dot.scale = 8,
              cols = "RdBu") +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color="black"), #面板边框
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
    #strip.background = element_rect(color="red"),
    strip.text = element_text(margin=margin(b=3, unit="mm")),
    strip.placement = 'outlet', 
    axis.line = element_blank(),
  ) +
  labs(x="", y="",title = "Top Driver Expression of the FAP Significant Pathway")
print(p)
cat("\n")
dev.off()
```

```{r Volcano_DE_MEC}
DE_ASC<- read.csv("/Users/hueee/Lab/Feinberg\ Lab/Single_cell_adipose_tissue/subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/DE_results_ASC-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv")
head(DE_ASC) #gene p_val avg_log2FC pct.1 pct.2 p_val_adj

head(DE_ASC)
x <- DE_ASC

logFCcut <- 1 #log2-foldchange
pvalCut <- 1e-2 #P.value
adjPcut <- 0.1 #adj.P.value

#for advanced mode
logFCcut2 <- 2 
logFCcut3 <- 5
pvalCut2 <- 1e-10
pvalCut3 <- 1e-20

#置x，y軸的最大最小位置
xmin <- (range(x$logFC)[1]- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ 10))
xmax <- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ (10-range(x$logFC)[1]))
ymin <- 0
ymax <- -log10(sort(x$P.Value)[1]) * 1.1

# 基因名的颜色，需大于等于pathway的数量，这里自定义了足够多的颜色
mycol <- c("darkgreen","chocolate4","blueviolet","#223D6C","#D20A13","#088247","#58CDD9","#7A142C","#5D90BA","#431A3D","#91612D","#6E568C","#E0367A","#D8D155","#64495D","#7CC767")

# 複雜的的setting for color
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
cols <- rep("grey", n1)
names(cols)<- rownames(x)

#不同阈值的点的颜色
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#FB9A99"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- "#ED4F4F"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#B2DF8A"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#329E3F"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#f77e7e"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2]<- "#c21b2b"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#73b6f5"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#136cbf"
color_transparent <- adjustcolor(cols, alpha.f = 0.5)
x$color_transparent <- color_transparent

# 複雜的的setting for size
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
size <- rep(1, n1)

#不同阈值的点的大小
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC > logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC > logFCcut3]<- 6
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC < -logFCcut3]<- 6

# Construct the plot object
#BiocManager::install('ggthemes')
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)
library(gridExtra)
p1 <- ggplot(data=x, aes(logFC, -log10(P.Value), label = Gene, color = pathway)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = size, colour = x$color_transparent) +

  labs(x=bquote(~Log[2]~"(fold change)"), y=bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")), title="") + 
  ylim(c(ymin,ymax)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-5, -2,-logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2, 5), #刻度线的位置
    labels = c(-5, -2, -logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2 , 5),
    limits = c(-6.5, 6.5) #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看
  ) +
  #或用下面这行：
  #xlim(c(xmin, xmax)) + 

#画阈值分界线
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut, logFCcut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) + #虚线的形状和粗细
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
  
theme_bw(base_size = 10 #, base_family = "Times" #修改字体
         ) +
theme(panel.grid=element_blank())

p1 <- p1 + 
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut2, logFCcut2), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut2), color="grey40", 
             linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1)

# 显示 logFC > n 的基因的基因名
n = 2
p1 + geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC,
                         y = -log10(P.Value), 
                         label = ifelse(logFC > n & -log10(P.Value) > 5, rownames(x),"")),
                     colour="#9c0917", size = 3, box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),

  geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC, 
                      y = -log10(P.Value),
```

```{r Clustered_DotPlot}
p <- DotPlot(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new, 
              features = filtered_pathway_lists, 
              dot.scale = 8,
              cols = "RdBu") +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color="black"), #面板边框
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
    #strip.background = element_rect(color="red"),
    strip.text = element_text(margin=margin(b=3, unit="mm")),
    strip.placement = 'outlet', 
    axis.line = element_blank(),
  ) +
  labs(x="", y="",title = "Top Driver Expression of the ASC Significant Pathway")
print(p)
cat("\n")
dev.off()
```

# Canonical Pathway Comparison
```{r comparison}
library("tidyr")
library("readxl")
getwd()
data <- read_xlsx('./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/comparison_selected.xlsx')
colnames(data) <- c("Pathway","ASC", "FAP", "Areg", "ASC.p", "FAP.p", "Areg.p")

data[data=="N/A"] <- NA
data$Pathway <- reorder(data$Pathway, data$ASC, decreasing = F)
data <- data[order(reorder(data$Pathway, data$ASC, decreasing = F)),]
#data <- data[c(1:5,25:29),]
mydata1<-gather(data[,1:4], Group, `z.score`,-1)
mydata2<-gather(data[,c(1,5:7)], Group, `-logP`,-1)
mydata <- cbind(mydata1,`-logP`=mydata2$`-logP`)
#mydata$Group <- c(rep("ASC",40),rep("FAP",40), rep("Areg",40))
mydata$Group<-factor(mydata1$Group, levels=c("ASC", "FAP", "Areg"), ordered=T)

ggplot(mydata, aes(x=Group,y=Pathway,z.score))+
  geom_vline(aes(Group, Pathway, xintercept = 1:nrow(mydata)),size=15,colour="grey100",alpha=.5)+
  geom_vline(aes(Group, Pathway, xintercept = 1:nrow(mydata)),linetype="dashed",size=0.2)+
  geom_point(aes(Group, Pathway, size=`-logP`,color=as.numeric(z.score)))+
  scale_size_area(max_size=10)+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "brown", mid = "blanchedalmond", low = "lightseagreen", na.value="grey90")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0.5, vjust =0.5))+
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$Pathway), width = 50))+
  labs(x = "Group", 
       y = "Function Annotation",
       size = "-logP.value",
       color = "Z-score") 
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/results/ASC_FAP_Areg_comparison.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)
```

```{r Volcano_DE_PreA}
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2]<- "#c21b2b"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#73b6f5"

# 複雜的的setting for size

#不同阈值的点的大小

size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC > logFCcut3]<- 6
```

## Canonical Pathways
```{r IPA_PreA_cano}
data <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/PreA_pw_selected.xlsx")
data <- data[order(data$`zScore`, decreasing = TRUE),]
data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways` <- factor(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                                              levels = rev(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`))

data$Shape <- ifelse(data$zScore > 0, 24, ifelse(data$zScore < 0, 25, 21)) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$zScore > 0, "Up", ifelse(data$zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")), levels = c("Up", "Down","NA"))

# Plot
ggplot(data, aes(x=zScore, 
                 y=`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                 size=Ratio*100, 
                 shape=Regulation, 
                 color=`-log(p-value)`)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top Canonical Pathways in PreAs \n24-week HFSC Diet",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 47))+
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))
```

## Cano_ChordPlot
```{r cano_chord}
data <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/PreA_Chord_input.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- read.csv("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/DE_results_PreA-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv")
colnames(expr)[1] <- "ID"
colnames(expr)[3] <- "logFC"
expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
row.names(expr) <- expr$ID

#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data,!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)

# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)
logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
ID <- expr[ind,]$ID
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,ID,logFC)
rownames(mat2) <- mat2$ID
mat2 <- mat2 %>% dplyr::select(-ID)

#自定义颜色；
# mycol <- c("#9dacb3","#896f96","#003a6c","#db6000","#f2c76d","#0077c1","#d982ba","#5ea6a3")
# mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffd580","#ffeabf","#bfecff","#80d9ff","#005478","#0078ab")
# mycol <- c("#FFC0C6","#FF5630","#FA6A10","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#1C98B9","#B6AAE3")
mycol <- c("#FFC0C6","#FF5630","#F2A816","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#B6AAE3")
# mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478")
#mycol <- c("#ffadad","#ffd6a5","#fdffb6","#caffbf","#9bf6ff","#a0c4ff","#bdb2ff","#ffc6ff")
# mycol <- c("#7C4697","#5D90BA","#5ea6a3","#D8D155","#cf7685")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'),
        limit = c(1,0),
        title = "Genes Significantly Impacting Pathways \nin PreAs after 24-week HFSC Diet") 
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/Chord_PreA.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.65)
```

```{r Bubble_RMP_top}
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Significant DEGs in RMPs: Chow vs HFSC",
       size = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       x="LogFC", 
       y="Gene Symbol",
       color = "Gene Regulation",
       shape = "Gene Regulation")+
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-3, 9)  #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看 
  ) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))

# Save the plot
ggsave("/Users/hueee/Lab/Feinberg\ Lab/Single_cell_adipose_tissue/subset_ASPC/RMP_gex_plot.pdf", width=5, height=7, dpi=600)
ggsave("/Users/hueee/Lab/Feinberg\ Lab/Single_cell_adipose_tissue/subset_ASPC/RMP_gex_plot.png", width=5, height=7, dpi=600)
```

## Canonical Pathways
```{r IPA_RMP_cano}
data <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/RMP_pw_selected.xlsx")
data <- data[order(data$`zScore`, decreasing = TRUE),]
data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways` <- factor(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                                              levels = rev(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`))

data$Shape <- ifelse(data$zScore > 0, 24, ifelse(data$zScore < 0, 25, 21)) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$zScore > 0, "Up", ifelse(data$zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")), levels = c("Up", "Down","NA"))

# Plot
ggplot(data, aes(x=zScore, 
                 y=`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                 size=Ratio*100, 
                 shape=Regulation, 
                 color=`-log(p-value)`)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top Canonical Pathways in RMPs \n24-week HFSC Diet",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 47))+
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/Cano_RMP.pdf", width=7, height=6)
```

## Cano_ChordPlot
```{r cano_chord}
data <- read_excel("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/RMP_Chord_input.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- read.csv("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/DE_results_RMP-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv")
colnames(expr)[1] <- "ID"
colnames(expr)[3] <- "logFC"
expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
row.names(expr) <- expr$ID

#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data,!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)

# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)
logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
ID <- expr[ind,]$ID
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,ID,logFC)
rownames(mat2) <- mat2$ID
mat2 <- mat2 %>% dplyr::select(-ID)

#自定义颜色；
# mycol <- c("#9dacb3","#896f96","#003a6c","#db6000","#f2c76d","#0077c1","#d982ba","#5ea6a3")
# mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffd580","#ffeabf","#bfecff","#80d9ff","#005478","#0078ab")
# mycol <- c("#FFC0C6","#FF5630","#FA6A10","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#1C98B9","#B6AAE3")
mycol <- c("#FF5630","#F2A816","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#B6AAE3")
# mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478")
#mycol <- c("#ffadad","#ffd6a5","#fdffb6","#caffbf","#9bf6ff","#a0c4ff","#bdb2ff","#ffc6ff")
# mycol <- c("#7C4697","#5D90BA","#5ea6a3","#D8D155","#cf7685")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'),
        limit = c(1,0),
        title = "Genes Significantly Impacting Pathways \nin RMPs after 24-week HFSC Diet") 
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/Chord_RMP.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.65)
```
